the Education Lab at Volkswagen is a new organizational unit within the Volkswagen Group Academy.
the Volkswagen Group Education Lab successfully develops new solutions to meet user needs by combining a user centered approach with an incubator like environment.

the Education Lab's approach to develop new corporate education solutions based on target group centered problem finding and problem solving is an innovative and successful way to accelerate the digital transformation of learning within a traditional corporation.

the question of how to accelerate the digital transformation of corporate learning.
the development of a methodology for the Education Lab, which is used to derive new corporate learning solutions based on target group centered problem-solving.
the question how the Education Lab contributes to the digital transformation of corporate learning at Volkswagen and which lessons can be derived from this case.

the Volkswagen Education Lab provides a good example of how a corporate organization can successfully implement a new, innovative approach.
the Education Lab provides a valuable methodological contribution to the field of innovation management.
the Education Lab has a positive impact on the Volkswagen Group Academy's ability to develop innovative corporate education and training concepts.

the Education Lab is a good example of how to accelerate the digital transformation of corporate learning within a traditional organization.
